subject: Film & Cinema
title: Montage: Time Compressed
description: A short lesson to help you apply Montage: Time Compressed.

hook.text: Rocky trains for months in under three minutes. That's the power of a montage.

buildup.text: Montage compresses time by stringing together brief shots that show progression.

discovery.text: Eisenstein argued that montage creates meaning — two unrelated images combined produce a new idea.

twist.text: Overused montages feel lazy — a shortcut that replaces actual storytelling with a music video.

climax.text: Used well, montage is cinema's time machine. Used poorly, it's a cliché.

punchline.text: Three minutes of montage can contain a lifetime.

quiz.question: What is the primary function of a montage?
options: Compress time by showing progression through brief shots
